payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks if n+1 is divisible by LCM(1..k); if k>43, LCM exceeds 10^18 so answer No. Else compute LCM up to k and check divisibility.
payload.rationale: Not a search algorithm; uses number theory insight. The early exit mimics a bound but there is no branching. No backtracking, bitmask, DFS, or permutation enumeration.
